questions.question: In the early church, what did the believers do with the things they owned?

answers.text: They gave it all to the priests
They stored it all in the temple

questions.question: When Ananias and his wife Sapphira sold their property, what did Ananias do with the money?

answers.text: Kept back some and brought the rest
Brought every bit of it to the apostles
Gave all of it to his neighbors

questions.question: Peter said Satan had filled Ananias's heart to lie to whom about the money from his land?
After Peter confronted Ananias for lying about the money from his land, what happened to Ananias?

answers.text: He went to get the rest
